name: GDC Crypto Payments for WooCommerce
author: GDC Team

sections.description:
GDC Crypto Payments for WooCommerce adds Bitcoin payment support to WooCommerce with two ways to use the plugin:

  1. Free Self-Hosted Mode
    Connect your own BTCPay Server and accept payments directly through your infrastructure.

  2. Optional Managed Merchant Mode (Pro)
    Use an optional licensed merchant service for guided setup and managed merchant store provisioning.

Features:

  • WooCommerce crypto payment gateway
  • Self-hosted BTCPay integration
  • Merchant setup checklist dashboard
  • Wallet connection assistant (xpub / ypub / zpub)
  • Webhook registration and testing tools
  • Invoice tracking and payment logs
  • Direct wallet settlement
  • Optional managed merchant mode

Payments settle directly to the merchant wallet.

No seed phrases, private keys, or wallet passwords are ever requested.

External Services

This plugin can connect to external services depending on the payment mode selected by the merchant.

Go Digital Crew API

When optional Managed Merchant Mode is enabled, the plugin connects to the Go Digital Crew API at:

https://api.gdc.team

This service is used for:
– license activation and validation
– merchant store provisioning
– wallet connection setup
– managed invoice creation
– managed merchant store updates

Data sent may include:
– license key
– license email
– website URL
– plugin version
– wallet public key only (xpub, ypub, or zpub)
– order amount and currency
– order reference data required for invoice creation

This data is only sent when the merchant enables and uses optional Managed Merchant Mode features.

The plugin never sends:
– seed phrases
– private keys
– wallet passwords

Terms of Service:
https://ccp.gdc.team/terms/

Privacy Policy:
https://ccp.gdc.team/privacy-policy/

Remote Notices Service

The plugin may periodically connect to:

https://ccp.gdc.team/wp-json/ccp/v1/notice

This is used to retrieve plugin notices and announcements displayed in the WordPress admin dashboard.

No customer payment data or wallet credentials are sent to this service.

Terms of Service:
https://ccp.gdc.team/terms/

Privacy Policy:
https://ccp.gdc.team/privacy-policy/

Self-Hosted BTCPay Server

In Free Self-Hosted Mode, the plugin connects directly to the merchant-configured BTCPay Server instance in order to create invoices and process payment requests.

Data sent may include:
– order amount
– order currency
– order ID
– customer billing details required for invoice creation
– return URL
– webhook/callback URL

This service is fully controlled by the merchant.

Privacy

This plugin does not transmit payment funds.

Optional external service communication occurs only when Managed Merchant Mode is enabled.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > GDC Crypto Payments.
  4. Configure Self-Hosted BTCPay mode or optionally activate Managed Merchant Mode.
  5. Enable the gateway and run a test payment.
sections.faq:
Do you hold merchant funds?

No.
Payments settle directly to the merchant wallet.

Does the free version work without a license?

Yes.
Free Self-Hosted Mode works without a paid license.

Do I need my own BTCPay server?

For Free Self-Hosted Mode, yes.

Managed Merchant Mode is optional and available separately.

Which wallet keys are supported?

The wallet assistant supports xpub, ypub and zpub public keys.

Never enter a seed phrase or private key.

Does this support WooCommerce webhooks?

Yes.
Webhook registration and testing tools are included.
